title: 化学品安全
summary: 评估公司化学品安全管理，包括产品成分合规、监管处罚与安全风险评估。

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Chemical Safety Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how our outputs are determined. Chemical Safety is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the possible presence of harmful chemicals in their product portfolio, their potential exposure to strengthening or pending chemical regulations and their efforts to develop less-harmful alternatives.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍化学品安全关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解评估结果的形成方式。化学品安全属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型社会支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖产品组合中可能存在的有害化学品、日趋严格或待实施化学品法规带来的潜在风险敞口，以及开发危害较小替代品的措施。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to Section 2, Data, ratings and scores, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 2 节“数据、评级与得分”。

sections.title_cn: 化学品安全关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Chemical Safety Key Issue Score evaluates the company's level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue Score is based on the Exposure Score and the Management Score using the formula below. The Exposure Score and the Management Score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue Score.
blocks.content_cn: 化学品安全关键议题得分评估公司对该议题风险的敞口程度及管理情况。该关键议题得分根据下述公式，基于风险敞口得分和管理得分计算。两项得分的结合方式意味着：风险敞口越高，公司就需要展现越强的管理能力，才能取得相同的总体关键议题得分。

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $KI_{i}$ is the Key Issue Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $KI_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的关键议题得分。

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{i}$ is the Exposure Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $MGMT_{i}$ is the Management Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $MGMT_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的管理得分。

blocks.content: The Chemical Safety Management score is based on the weighted average of the relevant indicator scores, modified by controversies. Default indicator weights may be adjusted for the relevance of business activities; an indicator has zero weight when the company has no exposure to the activity it covers.
blocks.content_cn: 管理得分按适用指标得分加权平均，再按争议事件调整。指标采用默认权重，并可根据公司业务活动的相关性调整；公司对某指标覆盖的业务活动没有敞口时，该指标权重为零。

blocks.content: $$MGMT_i = \sum_j Indicator\_Score_{j,i} \times Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$$

MGMT_i denotes the Management score excluding controversies; j denotes an applicable indicator and i denotes the company. Component scores aggregate indicator scores using weights scaled within the component.
blocks.content_cn: MGMT_i为争议调整前的管理得分；j表示适用指标，i表示公司。组件得分按组件内重新归一化后的指标权重汇总，不应默认将各组件等权平均。

sections.title_cn: • 化学品淘汰计划的覆盖范围。

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of products or chemicals of concern that the company is targeting to phase out.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司计划逐步淘汰的产品或受关注化学品范围。

sections.title_en: • Level of efforts to identify substances for regulatory risk.
sections.title_cn: • 识别物质监管风险的工作程度。

blocks.content: Definition: The level of identification of chemicals that are regulated or have the potential to be regulated in the company's products. Best practice is to identify all chemicals.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：识别公司产品中已受监管或可能受监管化学品的程度。最佳实践是识别所有化学品。

sections.title_en: - Scope of disclosure of registration and use of regulated substances.
sections.title_cn: • 受监管物质注册与使用披露的覆盖范围。

blocks.content: Definition: The level of disclosure around substances that fall within regulatory registration requirements. Best practice is to disclose all regulatory registrations and use.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：对须进行监管注册的物质的披露程度。最佳实践是披露全部监管注册及使用情况。

sections.title_en: • Environmental and health standards in new product design.
sections.title_cn: • 新产品设计中的环境与健康标准。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has a formal process to apply environmental and health standards in new product design.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否建立在新产品设计中应用环境与健康标准的正式流程。

sections.title_en: - Demonstrated track record of reducing reliance on substances of concern.
sections.title_cn: • 已有减少依赖受关注物质的实绩。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has demonstrated a track record of introducing viable alternatives to high-concern substances. Applies specifically to chemical producers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否已有引入高度关注物质可行替代品的实绩。专门适用于化学品生产商。

sections.title_en: - Demonstrated track record of reducing reliance on substances of concern.
sections.title_cn: • 已有减少依赖受关注物质的实绩。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has demonstrated a track record of introducing viable alternatives to high-concern substances. Applies specifically to product manufacturers other than chemical producers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否已有引入高度关注物质可行替代品的实绩。专门适用于化学品生产商以外的产品制造商。

sections.title_en: - Initiatives to improve consumer awareness on product chemical content.
sections.title_cn: • 提高消费者对产品化学成分认知的举措。

blocks.content: Definition: The level of initiatives to improve consumer awareness on product chemical content through channels that are easy for consumers to access. Best practice is to provide information regarding product chemical content and usage to consumers. Applies specifically to product manufacturers.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：通过消费者易于获取的渠道，提高其对产品化学成分认知的举措程度。最佳实践是向消费者提供产品化学成分及使用信息。专门适用于产品制造商。

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management Score, based on the severity and type of controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment.
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在此关键议题上所涉争议的严重程度及类型，从总体管理得分中扣减 0—5 分。评估采用以下争议类别。

blocks.content: For more details on how controversies are included in the MSCI ESG Ratings model, refer to Section 3.3.2, Controversies cases, of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于争议如何纳入 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 3.3.2 节“争议案例”。

sections.title_cn: 化学品安全风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Chemical Safety Exposure Score evaluates the company's exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Geographic Exposure Scores. The Geographic Exposure Score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure Score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business and Geographic Exposure Scores are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to Section 3.2, Analyzing risk exposure, of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure Score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 化学品安全敞口得分评估公司对该关键议题风险的敞口程度。它基于业务敞口得分和地理敞口得分计算。地理敞口得分作为业务敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为-50%至+50%。业务敞口得分和地理敞口得分均按0-10分制评分，10分对应最高风险，0分对应最低风险。更多细节请参阅《ESG评级方法论》第3.2节"风险敞口分析"。敞口得分按以下公式计算：

blocks.content:
$$
E X P _ {C H S, i} = B U S _ {C H S, i} (1 + 0. 1 \bigl (G E O _ {C H S, i} - 5 \bigr))
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{CHS,i}$ is the Chemical Safety Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{CHS,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的化学品安全风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $BUS_{CHS,i}$ is the Business Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BUS_{CHS,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的业务风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $GEO_{CHS,i}$ is the Geographic Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $GEO_{CHS,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的地域风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure Score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI ESG Research uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure Score. Each business activity score is determined by an assessment of the number of harmful substances present in a business activity's products.
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI ESG 研究使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部风险敞口得分。各业务活动得分通过评估该活动产品中存在的有害物质数量确定。

blocks.content: \- $SVHC_{j}$ is the number of substances of very high concern present in business activity $j$ 's products.

blocks.content: Substances of very high concern are hazardous substances with severe consequences and carry a weight of 70%. The Substitute It Now list is a list of hazardous chemicals that are likely to face regulatory restrictions in the future and carry a weight of 30%.

blocks.content: The Current Regulation Score is assessed by analyzing the state of existing chemical safety regulation in the country. The criteria used for analysis are as follows:
blocks.content_cn: 当前监管得分通过分析该国现行化学品安全法规的状况评估，采用以下标准：

blocks.content: 1. Maintenance of a national inventory of hazardous chemicals.
blocks.content_cn: 1. 维护国家危险化学品名录。

blocks.content: 2. Assessment of the degree of restriction on chemicals.
blocks.content_cn: 2. 评估对化学品的限制程度。

blocks.content: 3. Implementation of toxicity testing and reporting requirements.
blocks.content_cn: 3. 实施毒性测试和报告要求。

blocks.content: 4. Scope of chemical registration and reporting, assessed based on notification requirements for chemicals and volume limits for notification.
blocks.content_cn: 4. 化学品注册和报告的覆盖范围，根据化学品通报要求及通报数量门槛评估。

blocks.content: 5. Presence of voluntary reporting requirements.
blocks.content_cn: 5. 是否存在自愿报告要求。

blocks.content: 6. Implementation of external commitments such as the Stockholm Convention and the Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals.
blocks.content_cn: 6. 履行《斯德哥尔摩公约》及《全球化学品统一分类和标签制度》等外部承诺。

blocks.content: 7. Consumer awareness of hazardous chemicals in the country.
blocks.content_cn: 7. 该国消费者对危险化学品的认知。

blocks.content: The Future Regulation Score is assessed by examining the scope of upcoming regulations or any significant updates to existing regulations in the country.
blocks.content_cn: 未来监管得分通过考察该国即将出台法规的覆盖范围，或现行法规的重大更新评估。

blocks.content: The following sources are used to determine the Chemical Safety Exposure Score: Danish Working Environment Authority, International Chemical Secretariat Substitute It Now List, Refinitiv, MSCI ESG Research, company disclosures.
blocks.content_cn: 以下来源用于确定化学品安全风险敞口得分：丹麦工作环境管理局、国际化学品秘书处“立即替代清单”、路孚特、MSCI ESG 研究及公司披露。
